newsitem.title: USA: Pharmaceutical names Kyle vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Pharmaceutical names Kyle vice chairman.

text.p: Pharmaceutical Marketing Services Inc said Thursday that it named Frederick Kyle vice chairman.

Kyle, who has been a director of company, will be responsible for worldwide commercial operations. His appointment will allow Chief Execeutive Dennis Turner to concentrate on long-term strategic requirements, the company said.
Chief Operating Officer Robert Frattaroli will concentrate solely on the program to divest communications and other non-core businesses, Pharmaceutical Marketing Services said.
The company also announced that Lyle Scritsmier, Chief Financial Officer, has resigned to join Scottsdale, Arizona-based Integrated Physician Networks Inc.
